verdict.rationale: Proa ships an official CLI (`cargo install proa-cli`) whose `proa new site hello-proa --yes` command scaffolds a minimal Axum app, with an `origin` template as a kitchen-sink starter. The docs then describe starting the dev server on localhost:3000 with automatic restarts, which covers both scaffolding and running. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that setup actually completes in a few minutes (all evidence is first-party docs).

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote: A minimal Axum-backed application with the core boundaries in place: proa new site hello-proa --yes
proa new site origin-atlas --template origin --yes ... This scaffolds ORIGIN, a live routing atlas that exercises the whole framework
starts the Axum server on http://localhost:3000, and restarts when Rust, style, or config files change
